name: Jumbo "Lasagna" Pasta Shells Bites with Ground Beef, Marinara, Mozzarella, Ricotta & Basil (Kid-Friendly)

instructions.primary_message: Preheat oven to 400°F. Coat 12 muffin cups with oil and set aside.

Fill a large pot two-thirds with hot water (from the tap). Add salt, cover, and bring to a boil over high heat. Once boiling, uncover, add pasta, and stir for a few seconds; cook until very tender and pliable, 10-12 minutes (the shells should be very flexible). Drain and rinse under cold water to cool.
instructions.secondary_message:
½ tsp salt
16 jumbo pasta shells

instructions.primary_message: While the shells are cooking, preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, peel, halve, and small dice onion; peel and mince garlic.
instructions.secondary_message:
½ medium yellow onion
2 clove garlic

instructions.primary_message: Once the skillet is hot, add onion, garlic, beef, and spices; cook, breaking the meat apart with a spoon, until browned and crumbly, 5-6 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
12 oz lean ground beef
½ tsp Italian seasoning
¼ tsp salt
⅛ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, wash, dry, and pick basil leaves off the stems; roll up crosswise and thinly slice into ribbons. Place in a small bowl, along with ricotta and spices, then stir to combine.
instructions.secondary_message:
½ small pkg fresh basil
½ (15 oz) pkg ricotta cheese
¼ tsp salt
⅛ tsp crushed red pepper
⅛ tsp black pepper
⅛ tsp nutmeg, ground

instructions.primary_message: When the beef is done, add marinara sauce to the skillet and stir to combine. Continue to cook, stirring occasionally, until sauce thickens slightly, 3-4 minutes more. Remove from heat.
When the shells are done, carefully turn them inside out and arrange in the muffin cups (if any shells tear, replace with spare cooked shells).
Place a generous tablespoon of ricotta mixture in the bottom of each shell. Add 2 tbsp meat sauce to each cup, then sprinkle with mozzarella.
Place muffin pan in the oven and bake until filling is heated through and cheese is golden and bubbly, 18-20 minutes. Remove from oven and let stand, 5 minutes.
Transfer to a serving platter, sprinkle with Parmesan, and enjoy!
